features.name: Versioned design specification validation
features.description: Validate schema 1.0 documents, supported node fields including bounded rotation, frame/component clipsContent and per-corner radius/smoothing, bounded image/vector assets, design tokens including letter/paragraph spacing, text case/decoration, vertical alignment and resize mode, constraints/grids, component references, paint properties, IDs and resource limits.
features.nextAction: Define forward schema migration policy and expand round-trip coverage for unsupported image paint/effect combinations.

features.name: Native Figma rendering and asset insertion
features.description: Create editable native frames, groups, components/instances with bounded rotation, frame/component clipping and per-corner radius/smoothing, vectors, bounded raster fills, gradients, bounded solid/linear-gradient/radial-gradient/angular-gradient/diamond-gradient/image paint stacks, rectangle/ellipse strokes, line strokes with opacity, drop/inner shadows and normal/progressive blur effects, token-bound colors and typography styles with exported token definitions and bindings, case, decoration, letter/paragraph spacing, vertical alignment and text sizing, responsive constraints and layout grids.
knownIssues: Native rendering and asset operations have automated coverage but are NOT TESTED in live Figma; selected export intentionally rejects unsupported paint/effect/stroke cases.
features.nextAction: Finish the CODE-02 schema-property fidelity matrix; verify native behavior in a live Figma editor when the desktop is available.

features.name: Selection inspection and edit patches
features.description: Bounded selection inspection and targeted text, fill, image replacement, rename, bounds, frame Auto Layout, and selected instance-to-component swaps with up to 20 session undo checkpoints.
knownIssues: Live Figma preservation, image replacement/crop, component override behavior and Undo remain unverified.
features.nextAction: Verify image replacement/crop, targeted edits, component swap and Undo in live Figma.

features.name: Selected design export
features.description: Export one selected supported layer tree to a validated design specification, preserving geometry, rotation, supported text styles and token definitions/bindings, images/crop data, component references, vectors, gradient transforms, effects, frame/component clipping and corner styles, line stroke opacity, responsive layout, and paint stacks; reject mixed text tokens/styles and unsupported native data that schema 1.0 cannot represent.
knownIssues: A schema-property fidelity matrix is still being completed under CODE-02. Live Figma round-trip is NOT TESTED. Native unsupported paint/effect/stroke/node types, mixed text font/line-height styles, multiple text color variables, unresolved token modes, and inaccessible component sources are rejected explicitly.
features.nextAction: Complete the CODE-02 field-by-field schema matrix and close each remaining export-property evidence gap; run the live Figma export/import smoke test separately.

features.name: Provider-neutral AI handoff
features.description: Prepare provider-neutral generation/edit prompts with category-specific design recipes, schema 1.0 feature guidance, local design tokens and validated JSON output.
features.nextAction: Keep category recipes synchronized with schema and renderer capability changes.

features.name: Optional local Ollama adapter
features.description: Discover installed local Ollama models and stream bounded, category-specific schema 1.0 generation or safe selection patches over loopback.
knownIssues: Stream contract is integration-tested against a fake local server; no installed Ollama model or hardware has been exercised. Detailed CPU/GPU diagnostics and bounded automatic invalid-output repair are not implemented.
features.nextAction: Verify streaming against an installed Ollama/model and add capability diagnostics without inferring unobservable hardware.

features.name: VSN startup loader and plugin panel
features.description: Show bundled VSN logo loader and load responsive plugin workflows.
features.nextAction: Complete broader UI accessibility and visual QA.

features.name: Loopback companion HTTP service
features.description: Serve optional local model endpoints with origin checks, payload bounds and loopback binding.
features.nextAction: Keep runtime and future bridge endpoints separated by contract.

features.name: Custom MCP server and asset tools
features.description: Expose validated Figma selection, design operations and manual asset import/validation to compatible MCP clients through the official SDK.
knownIssues: Client-specific registration and live Figma invocation are not tested; large raster batch transfer is automated-tested but not live-verified.
features.nextAction: Test asset tools through a live Figma pairing and actual MCP client file-transfer capability.

features.name: Authenticated local Figma bridge
features.description: Correlate, queue and return MCP-originated operations for paired plugin sessions over loopback.
knownIssues: Local machine pairing is required; no remote bridge is supported.
features.nextAction: Keep bridge bound to loopback and confirm browser Figma pairing on a desktop host.

features.name: Live agent activity and jobs
features.description: Show the signed-in Figma operator and live agent job state; keep a paired job poller alive while the plugin panel is hidden.
knownIssues: Automated checks cover plugin-host JSVM compatibility; hidden-panel operation and Figma account display have not yet been exercised in a live Figma session. Closing Figma or the document terminates this plugin session; automatic new-file creation is not implemented.
features.nextAction: Re-import the build, pair once, verify the signed-in operator, hide the panel and confirm one real Claude job completes; then scope a separate local desktop runner for new/closed files.

features.name: Figma compatibility adapter and matrix
features.description: Map schema Auto Layout modes and primary-axis alignments to and from the official Figma Plugin API typings; report unknown native values instead of silently coercing them.
knownIssues: Only Auto Layout mode and primary-axis alignment mappings are isolated so far; other Figma-specific paint, text, grid and variable APIs remain in the renderer. Live-version behavior is not tested.
features.nextAction: Extract remaining schema-to-Figma mappings and verify behavior in the supported Figma editor versions.

features.name: AI-readable repository memory and audits
features.description: Keep source-backed registry, status, handoff and docs validation synchronized.
features.nextAction: Keep the execution plan, agent rules, README gate table, status and handoff coherent; regenerate traceability and run the strict docs audit after changes.

features.name: UTF-8 bounded size accounting
features.description: Measure JSON text by UTF-8 bytes so non-ASCII input cannot bypass size limits.
features.nextAction: Keep byte-limit edge cases in schema regression tests.

features.name: Validated local raster and SVG import and reuse
features.description: Validate bounded SVG and PNG/JPEG/GIF payloads; support 5 MiB raster import through atomic, SHA-256 verified 64 KiB MCP chunks; insert natively, verify node readback, and persist originals in the paired local bridge library.
knownIssues: Live Figma insertion, paired bridge persistence and large MCP transfer remain unverified; generated AI file retrieval varies by client and is not inferred. Image replacement/crop are targeted edit patches rather than standalone asset-import operations.
features.nextAction: Re-import the current build, pair Claude from plugin Settings, and verify SVG/raster save, preview/reuse, reload persistence, and a raster larger than 192 KiB through the paired MCP bridge.

features.name: Advisory design specification quality audit
features.description: Give non-blocking, path-specific findings for low text contrast against known solid fills, generic layer names, unspecified font sizes, and repeated containers that omit Auto Layout; improve the provider-neutral prompt with concrete design-quality instructions.
knownIssues: Does not inspect rendered pixels, detect all overlap/responsive issues, or establish subjective design quality; Figma Agent comparison requires a controlled live evaluation.
features.nextAction: Add live screenshot-based review and repeatable same-brief comparison when Figma and candidate model environments are available.

features.name: AI-orchestrated Figma visual feedback loop
features.description: Select the first generated root frame, export one selected frame as a size-bounded JPEG from the Figma host, return it as an MCP image block on job retrieval, and allow an AI client to inspect, patch and capture again.
knownIssues: Live Figma export, preview image delivery to a real Claude Desktop session, and multi-round visual repair are not tested. Plugin does not autonomously call the AI client.
features.nextAction: Reimport the build, render a design, request a preview through Claude MCP, confirm Claude receives the actual image, apply one safe patch, and capture again.
